description:
Search currently registered domains that carry marketplace listing data, filtered by keyword, TLD, listing status, length, and character set. Results are live domains owned by someone.

Related: keyword_data, tld_check.

keyword.description: Brand or industry term (min 2 chars). Substring matching applies at every length, including 2-character terms.

position.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'all' (substring match).

status.description: Filter by status: 'forsale' for domains listed for sale

tld.description: Filter by TLD (e.g., 'com', 'net', 'org'). Provide WITHOUT keyword to enter TLD browse mode (gTLDs only; requires a registered account)

tld_count_max.description: Maximum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. See tld_count_min.

tld_count_min.description: Minimum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. Combine with tld_count_max for a range; set both equal for an exact count. Matches the prefix_tld_count field in results.

name: market

components.description: Word segmentation of the domain prefix

marketplace.description: Sale platform code where the domain is listed: se=Sedo, go=GoDaddy, at=Atom, vn=Venture, pd=PerfectDomain, gn=Gname. Present only when the domain is listed for sale.

prefix_tld_count.description: Number of TLDs this prefix is registered across

price.description: Listing price with currency, e.g. 1500 USD. Only present for Atom/Sedo listings

total.description: Number of results on this page

total_found.description: Total matching results across all pages

title: Domain Marketplace Search
